source: the owner's OpenAI pricing page (2026-09-23) and the coordinator's token table for the gpt-image-2.5 models (2026-09-23)
notes: per_image: the price of one output image by size and quality; the API bills tokens, these rows are the pricing page's summary.
A model without a per_image row is estimated from output_tokens x token price and flagged as token-estimated.
A size without its own row is estimated from the row with the same pixel count, else the 1024x1024 row scaled by pixel count, and flagged.

reference_image_tokens_estimate: input image tokens of one square reference of reference_image_size px (gpt-image-1 rule: 194 tile tokens + 4160 high-fidelity tokens), scaled by pixel area for smaller references (--ref-size). Undocumented for the gpt-image-2 and 2.5 models; an assumption, always flagged. Compare with the usage of a real run.
input_fidelity: null means the field is not sent. gpt-image-2 rejects or ignores it and it is undocumented for 2.5; gpt-image-1, 1.5 and 1-mini accept "high" or "low".
The Batch API (50% discount) is not supported for the gpt-image-2.5 models and is not used by this tool.
